promises.statement: We will achieve twice the market growth rate.
promises.quote: Sir, revenue growth, we have committed the 2x of the market growth.
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar, Managing Director
promises.actual: YTD FY27 incomplete
promises.verdict: Target due for FY27; period is ongoing.

promises.statement: We are targeting a full year revenue of INR450 to INR500 crores combined between OSAT and PCB.
promises.quote: and we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time, we are on the target.
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar, Managing Director
promises.actual: YTD FY27 incomplete
promises.verdict: Full year target for OSAT and PCB combined is pending FY27 completion.

promises.statement: We will turn cash positive by the end of the financial year.
promises.quote: that whatever the commitment that we have given to you as a leadership team, that by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive, we are pretty confident on that.
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar, Managing Director
promises.actual: YTD FY27 incomplete
promises.verdict: Target for cash positive status applies to end of FY27.

promises.statement: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27.
promises.quote: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27, and we will continue to update you transparently on our progress every quarter.
promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
promises.actual: Due Q3 FY27
promises.verdict: Target date Q3 FY27 has not yet been reported.

promises.statement: Our capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business.
promises.quote: We said we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business.
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar, Managing Director
promises.actual: INR 230 crore spent in Q1 FY27
promises.verdict: Annual capex target of INR 850 crore is ongoing for FY27.

promises.statement: Increase the contribution of new product development-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of total revenue.
promises.quote: and our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue in the coming years.
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar, Managing Director
promises.actual: No breakdown of value-added/NPD revenue proportion provided in financials.
promises.verdict: Product-mix percentage details are not available in financial reports.

promises.statement: Reverse the smart meter business working capital trend and bring it back to positive in three quarters.
promises.quote: Rest assured, ladies and gentlemen, we'll be able to bring it back at least to a level of reduction... and we will come back in 3 quarters with positive results on specifically this entity.
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar, Managing Director
promises.actual: Smart meter working capital trend being monitored over 3 quarters
promises.verdict: Three quarters timeline post May 2026 call has not concluded.

promises.statement: Rail business is expected to grow by around 20% to 25% this year.
promises.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.
promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan, Executive Vice Chairman
promises.actual: Rail segment specific revenue growth not separately reported in tables.
promises.verdict: Segmental financial details for rail business are unavailable.

promises.statement: Rail business margins are going to be north of current 30% plus.
promises.quote: And the margins are going to be north of current 30% plus.
promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan, Executive Vice Chairman
promises.actual: Rail segment margin details not split in reporting.
promises.verdict: Rail business operating margin is not reported separately.

promises.statement: Stand-alone EMS business will improve working capital days by 8 to 10 days in the years to come.
promises.quote: you can rest assured that Kaynes stand-alone, the EMS business will continue to be cash positive, and we'll be improving it at least by about 8 to 10 days in the years to come in this segment.
promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar, Managing Director
promises.actual: Standalone EMS specific working capital days breakdown not disclosed.
promises.verdict: Standalone EMS working capital days are not reported.

promises.statement: Expect net working capital days of about 70 to 85 days.
promises.quote: So typically, what we expect is about between 70 to 85 days.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath, CFO
promises.actual: Cash conversion cycle was 193 days in Mar 2026
promises.verdict: Working capital days of 193 for FY26 significantly missed the 70-85 days target.

promises.statement: At the consolidated level, we will definitely be operating cash flow positive by the end of this year.
promises.quote: And going forward, at consol level, we'll definitely be OCF positive by end of this year.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath, CFO
promises.actual: Cash from operations was INR -600 crore in Mar 2026
promises.verdict: Failed to achieve positive operating cash flow for FY26.

promises.statement: Targeting a $1 billion revenue for fiscal 2028.
promises.quote: I mean, you reiterated your $1 billion guidance for fiscal '28.
promises.speaker: Sameet Sinha and Jairam Sampath
promises.actual: Target due in FY28
promises.verdict: Long term revenue target of $1 billion is due in FY28.

promises.statement: We will get rid of smart meter non-current receivables with appropriate financing before the year is over.
promises.quote: So going forward, we will make sure that before this year is over, we get rid of these receivables with appropriate financing so that it's not in our books
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath
promises.actual: Off-balance sheet/financing clearance of smart meter receivables not explicitly reported.
promises.verdict: Financial data does not isolate smart meter receivable financing status.

promises.statement: We will endeavor to make sure that these do not cross collection periods of 90 days.
promises.quote: And we will endeavor to make sure that these do not cross collection periods of 90 days, etc.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath
promises.actual: Cash conversion cycle ballooned to 193 days in Mar 2026
promises.verdict: Collection periods expanded substantially above 90 days by year end.

promises.statement: We will hit the annual number for our profits as well as operating EBITDA and broadly reach the revenue targets also that we have mentioned.
promises.quote: So quarterly basis, you might see some little dips here and there, but we are pretty confident that we will hit the annual number for our profits as well as operating EBITDA and broadly reach the revenue targets also that we have mentioned.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath, Whole-Time Director and CFO
promises.actual: FY26 Revenue was INR 3626 crore vs guidance INR 4500 crore+
promises.verdict: FY26 top-line missed previous target by a substantial margin.

promises.statement: We will have positive OCF and lower net working capital by the end of this year.
promises.quote: So we will have positive OCF, and we'll have lower net working capital by the end of this year.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath, Whole-Time Director and CFO
promises.actual: CFO was INR -600 crore and cash cycle hit 193 days in Mar 2026
promises.verdict: OCF remained negative and net working capital days increased sharply.

promises.statement: The first phase of the PCB plant in Oragadam will be ready by the end of this year.
promises.quote: And we think that by the end of this year, the plant should be ready and at least the Phase 1 in the Oragadam area.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath, Whole-Time Director and CFO
promises.actual: Plant operational status is not recorded in financial tables.
promises.verdict: Operational readiness of Oragadam plant is unverifiable via financials.

promises.statement: We will start shipping PC boards from the month of April onwards.
promises.quote: And once that is ready, then maybe some customers approvals also will be there, and we'll start shipping like I have communicated earlier from the month of April onwards.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath, Whole-Time Director and CFO
promises.actual: Shipping start dates are not recorded in financial statements.
promises.verdict: Product shipping dates cannot be verified through financial statements.

promises.statement: We maintain our guidance of INR 4,500 crores plus on a consolidated basis.
promises.quote: So we maintain our what I call the guidance of INR4,500 crores plus on a consol basis.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath, CFO
promises.actual: FY26 Revenue reached INR 3626 crore
promises.verdict: Revenue fell short of the INR 4,500 crore guidance for FY26.

promises.statement: Our net working capital target is 70 days without extraordinary items by the end of the year.
promises.quote: So our target is 70 days without this extraordinary item. Hopefully, we'll find a solution for it before the second half starts.
promises.speaker: Jairam Sampath, CFO
promises.actual: Cash conversion cycle reached 193 days in Mar 2026
promises.verdict: Working capital days exceeded sub-70 day target substantially.

promises.statement: The OSAT plant in Sanand will be fully operational for commercial production by December 2025.
promises.quote: and is on track to be fully operational for commercial production by December '25.
promises.speaker: Ramesh Kannan, Managing Director
promises.actual: Commercial production dates are not tracked in reporting.
promises.verdict: Sanand OSAT operational status cannot be verified from tables.

promises.statement: The multilayer HDI PCB plant in Chennai will reach operational readiness by January 2026.
promises.quote: and operational readiness expected by January 2026.
promises.speaker: Ramesh Kannan, Managing Director
promises.actual: Operational readiness dates are not reported in numbers.
promises.verdict: Chennai PCB plant readiness status is unverifiable from numbers.

deliveredSummary: Management repeatedly missed FY26 commitments, delivering INR 3,626 crore revenue against INR 4,500+ crore guidance. Cash flow from operations plunged to INR -600 crore alongside a sharp worsening in working capital days to 193.

divergences.story: Management maintained optimism on reaching FY26 targets and operating cash flow positive status.
divergences.numbers: FY26 revenue missed guidance significantly, and operating cash flow fell to INR -600 crore.

divergences.story: Management guided working capital days down towards 70-85 days by FY26 end.
divergences.numbers: Cash conversion cycle spiked upward from 102 days to 193 days in Mar 2026.

bull: Revenue grew 33.2% in FY26 to reach INR 3,626 crore.
EBITDA margin expanded steadily to 16.0% in FY26.
Order book expanded to INR 9,000 crore by Q1 FY27.
bear: Cash from operations collapsed to INR -600 crore in FY26.
Cash conversion cycle deteriorated sharply from 102 days to 193 days in FY26.
FY26 revenue missed management's INR 4,500 crore target by nearly INR 874 crore.
business: Kaynes Technology is an IoT solutions-enabled electronics manufacturing company providing design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support across automotive, industrial, aerospace, defense, medical, railways, and smart metering segments.
